CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_OCTOPUS_FIST_RUNE.title: Octopus Fist
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_OCTOPUS_FIST_RUNE.descri: Your [gold]Break Down[/gold] becomes: double damage dealt.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_BANSOGO_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Bandage
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EASY_MEMORY_RUNE.title: Easy Memory
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EASY_MEMORY_RUNE.flavor: [b][red]Only the god of my oblivion may not be forgotten.[/red][/b]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_WHITE_BIRTHDAY_RUNE.desc: After playing [gold]Black Birthday[/gold], heal the HP it cost you.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAREFREE_RUNE.title: Carefree
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAREFREE_RUNE.flavor: [b][blue]Ave Mujica? There's no such word. You made it up. [/blue][/b]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_ALL_MEMORIES_RUNE.title: All Memories
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_ALL_MEMORIES_RUNE.descri: At the start of each combat, choose any number of cards to gain [gold]Memory[/gold] and cost 0.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_ALL_MEMORIES_RUNE.select: Choose any number of cards. They will gain [gold]Memory[/gold] and cost 0 this combat.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_NONSTOP_PERFORMANCE_RUNE: Whenever you play a [gold]Chord[/gold], draw 1 card.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PRESSURE_TRANSFER_RUNE.d: The first time you gain [gold]Pressure[/gold] each turn, also apply that much [gold]Pressure[/gold] to a random enemy.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PRESSURE_TRANSFER_RUNE.f: [color=#7799CC]Play if you want. It's nothing to do with me.[/color]
The first time your [gold]Pressure[/gold] would reach your HP each combat, don't [gold]Break Down[/gold]. Instead remove all [gold]Pressure[/gold] and gain Block equal to it.
[color=#7799CC]Ave Mujica is all I have left.[/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PRESSURE_INTO_STRENGTH_R: The Strength from your [gold]Pressure[/gold]-to-Strength effect becomes permanent.
[color=#7799CC]Spare me your concern. The weakling I was is already dead.[/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FORGET_MASTER_RUNE.title: Master of Forgetting
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FORGET_MASTER_RUNE.descr: Whenever you [red]Forget[/red] a card, draw 1 card.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_MEMORY_FLOOD_RUNE.title: Memory Flood
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_MEMORY_FLOOD_RUNE.descri: At the start of each combat, add 3 random upgraded [gold]Memory[/gold] cards to your hand.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_MEMORY_FLOOD_RUNE.flavor: [color=#7799CC]What if I start to miss it again?[/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PRESSURE_ART_RUNE.title: Pressure as Art
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PRESSURE_ART_RUNE.descri: Each stack of [gold]Pressure[/gold] increases your attack damage by +1%. You no longer [red]collapse[/red] when [gold]Pressure[/gold] exceeds your HP.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PRESSURE_ART_RUNE.flavor: [color=#7799CC]Gods don't exist. I will become one![/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_BEAT_GUARD_RUNE.title: Beat Guard
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_BEAT_GUARD_RUNE.descript: The first time you gain a Note each turn, gain 4 Block.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PERFECT_PITCH_RUNE.title: Perfect Pitch
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PERFECT_PITCH_RUNE.descr: All [gold]Chords[/gold] you play get +1 to their values.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PERFECT_PITCH_RUNE.flavo: [color=#FF8899]I'm not giving up, and neither should you, Soyorin![/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FIRST_ENCORE_RUNE.title: First Encore
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FIRST_ENCORE_RUNE.descri: The first [gold]Chord[/gold] you play each combat gets +3 to its value.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_SPARE_PICK_RUNE.title: Spare Pick
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_SPARE_PICK_RUNE.descript: At the start of your turn, if you have no stored [gold]Chords[/gold], add 1 random [gold]Chord[/gold] to your stored Chords.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_SPARE_PICK_RUNE.flavor: [color=#FF8899]Even I can do at least this much![/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_QUARTET_RUNE.title: Quartet
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_QUARTET_RUNE.flavor: [color=#FF8899]One band, five girls, a lifetime stage.[/color]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAT_GRATITUDE_RUNE.title: Cat's Gratitude
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAT_GRATITUDE_RUNE.descr: Whenever you gain a [gold]Cat[/gold] card, gain 3 Block.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PARFAIT_TIME_RUNE.title: Parfait Time
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_PARFAIT_TIME_RUNE.descri: At the start of each combat, gain 3 [gold]Matcha Parfait[/gold] charges.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_SWEET_APPETITE_RUNE.desc: The first time you eat [gold]Matcha Parfait[/gold] each turn, draw 1 card.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_SWEET_APPETITE_RUNE.flav: [gold]Matcha should be served in the biggest cup![/gold]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FORGOTTEN_FLAVOR_RUNE.de: Eating [gold]Matcha Parfait[/gold] no longer adds Brain Freeze.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FORGOTTEN_FLAVOR_RUNE.fl: [gold]Matcha parfait. Yummy.[/gold][orange] (No such thing as brain freeze.)[/orange]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RANA_MOMENT_RUNE.title: Rana Moment
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RANA_MOMENT_RUNE.descrip: The first time you gain [gold]Live Sweet[/gold] each combat, heal 3 HP and gain 1 Energy.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RANA_MOMENT_RUNE.flavor: [gold]Happiness is: lives, matcha, petting cats, soba and orange jelly.[/gold]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_NEKO_KING_RUNE.title: Cat King
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_MEMORY_RESONANCE_RUNE.de: Whenever you play a [gold]Memory[/gold] card, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_FORGET_RITUAL_RUNE.title: Ritual of Forgetting
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_NOTE_ALCHEMY_RUNE.title: Note Alchemy
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_NOTE_ALCHEMY_RUNE.descri: When you play a [gold]Chord[/gold], it gains +1 value for every [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Notes[/gold] you have (no limit).
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RESONANCE_ECHO_RUNE.desc: The first time you play a [gold]Chord[/gold] each turn, add that [gold]Chord[/gold] back to your storage.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAT_GUARD_RUNE.title: Cat Guardianship
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAT_GUARD_RUNE.descripti: At end of turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [blue]Block[/blue] for each [gold]Cat[/gold] card in your hand.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAT_RESONANCE_RUNE.title: Cat Resonance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_CAT_RESONANCE_RUNE.descr: The first time you play a [gold]Cat[/gold] card each turn, add a copy of it to your hand.
